// GENERATED by python-multiplatform-gradle-plugin (GenerateAotLibraryBindingsTask). Do not edit.
//
// The FFM helper of a TypedPython AOT library's Kotlin wrappers (SPEC N-17, #458). The same text for every
// library, only the package line differs, so give each library its own package.
//
// What it is for. That a build can produce a C-ABI library a Kotlin app calls without CPython is owner decision
// D5 (2026-11-16). That the generated Kotlin is self-contained (java.lang.foreign reached by reflection, pointers
// as JAVA_LONG, calls through invokeExact) and that the desktop JVM comes first are leader decisions of
// 2026-11-16, not owner-confirmed. Everything else here (the names, the scratch memory, the descriptor strings) is
// an agent proposal, not owner-confirmed.
//
// It uses only the Kotlin standard library and java.base. java.lang.foreign is resolved reflectively ONCE, when
// the runtime object is created and when a symbol is bound; a call afterwards is a MethodHandle.invokeExact and
// nothing else (desktopMain README of python-multiplatform: "Reflection belongs at link time, never per call").
// Supported: java.lang.foreign of JDK 21 (a preview API: run with --enable-preview) and of JDK 22 and later.
// Not supported: the jdk.incubator.foreign of JDK 16 to 18, and JDK 19 and 20 (not tried).
@file:Suppress("unused", "RedundantVisibilityModifier")

package %PACKAGE%

import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandle
import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles
import java.lang.invoke.MethodType
import java.lang.reflect.Array as ReflectArray

/**
 * A failure of the compiled library, carrying what the Python language raises for the same call:
 * [className] is the exception class name (`ZeroDivisionError`, `IndexError`, ...) and [message] is `str(exception)`.
 */
class TypedPythonAotException(val className: String, message: String) : RuntimeException(message) {
    override fun toString(): String = className + ": " + message
}

/** The one runtime object of this package, created on first use. */
internal object AotFfm {
    @Volatile
    private var instance: AotFfmRuntime? = null

    @Synchronized
    fun runtime(): AotFfmRuntime {
        val existing = instance
        if (existing != null) return existing
        val created = AotFfmRuntime()
        instance = created
        return created
    }
}

/**
 * java.lang.foreign behind plain Kotlin types: pointers are `Long`, a symbol is bound to a [MethodHandle] whose type
 * is made of `long`, `double`, `byte`, `int` only, and memory is read and written at a `Long` address.
 */
internal class AotFfmRuntime {
    private val linker: Any
    private val loaderLookup: Any
    private val lookupFind: java.lang.reflect.Method
    private val downcallHandleMethod: java.lang.reflect.Method
    private val functionDescriptorOf: java.lang.reflect.Method
    private val functionDescriptorOfVoid: java.lang.reflect.Method
    private val memoryLayoutClass: Class<*>
    private val noOptions: Any
    private val layoutLong: Any
    private val layoutDouble: Any
    private val layoutByte: Any
    private val layoutInt: Any

    private val getLong: MethodHandle
    private val getDouble: MethodHandle
    private val getByte: MethodHandle
    private val putLong: MethodHandle
    private val putDouble: MethodHandle
    private val putByte: MethodHandle

    private val allocateExact: MethodHandle
    private val addressExact: MethodHandle

    /** Native memory that the garbage collector frees once its thread is gone; `keep` holds it reachable. */
    private class Scratch(val keep: Any, val address: Long)

    private val scratchLocal: ThreadLocal<Scratch>

    init {
        val memorySegmentClass = foreign("MemorySegment")
        val arenaClass = foreign("Arena")
        val linkerClass = foreign("Linker")
        val symbolLookupClass = foreign("SymbolLookup")
        val functionDescriptorClass = foreign("FunctionDescriptor")
        val valueLayoutClass = foreign("ValueLayout")
        memoryLayoutClass = foreign("MemoryLayout")
        val optionClass = foreign("Linker\$Option")
        val lookup = MethodHandles.lookup()
        val longType = Long::class.javaPrimitiveType!!

        linker = linkerClass.getMethod("nativeLinker").invoke(null)
        loaderLookup = symbolLookupClass.getMethod("loaderLookup").invoke(null)
        lookupFind = symbolLookupClass.getMethod("find", String::class.java)
        val optionArrayClass = ReflectArray.newInstance(optionClass, 0).javaClass
        noOptions = ReflectArray.newInstance(optionClass, 0)
        downcallHandleMethod = linkerClass.getMethod(
            "downcallHandle", memorySegmentClass, functionDescriptorClass, optionArrayClass,
        )
        val layoutArrayClass = ReflectArray.newInstance(memoryLayoutClass, 0).javaClass
        functionDescriptorOf = functionDescriptorClass.getMethod("of", memoryLayoutClass, layoutArrayClass)
        functionDescriptorOfVoid = functionDescriptorClass.getMethod("ofVoid", layoutArrayClass)
        layoutLong = valueLayoutClass.getField("JAVA_LONG").get(null)
        layoutDouble = valueLayoutClass.getField("JAVA_DOUBLE").get(null)
        layoutByte = valueLayoutClass.getField("JAVA_BYTE").get(null)
        layoutInt = valueLayoutClass.getField("JAVA_INT").get(null)

        // Memory at an absolute address: the segment that covers the whole address space, bound in as the
        // receiver, so that an access is a handle of type (long) -> T or (long, T) -> void.
        val everything = memorySegmentClass.getMethod("reinterpret", longType)
            .invoke(memorySegmentClass.getField("NULL").get(null), Long.MAX_VALUE)
        fun reader(layout: Any, ofName: String): MethodHandle {
            val ofClass = foreign("ValueLayout\$" + ofName)
            return MethodHandles.insertArguments(
                lookup.unreflect(memorySegmentClass.getMethod("get", ofClass, longType)), 0, everything, layout,
            )
        }
        fun writer(layout: Any, ofName: String, valueType: Class<*>): MethodHandle {
            val ofClass = foreign("ValueLayout\$" + ofName)
            return MethodHandles.insertArguments(
                lookup.unreflect(memorySegmentClass.getMethod("set", ofClass, longType, valueType)), 0, everything, layout,
            )
        }
        getLong = reader(layoutLong, "OfLong")
        getDouble = reader(layoutDouble, "OfDouble")
        getByte = reader(layoutByte, "OfByte")
        putLong = writer(layoutLong, "OfLong", longType)
        putDouble = writer(layoutDouble, "OfDouble", Double::class.javaPrimitiveType!!)
        putByte = writer(layoutByte, "OfByte", Byte::class.javaPrimitiveType!!)

        val autoArena = arenaClass.getMethod("ofAuto").invoke(null)
        allocateExact = MethodHandles.insertArguments(
            lookup.unreflect(arenaClass.getMethod("allocate", longType, longType)), 0, autoArena,
        ).asType(MethodType.methodType(Any::class.java, longType, longType))
        addressExact = lookup.unreflect(memorySegmentClass.getMethod("address"))
            .asType(MethodType.methodType(longType, Any::class.java))
        scratchLocal = ThreadLocal.withInitial {
            val segment = allocateExact.invokeExact(SCRATCH_BYTES, 16L) as Any
            Scratch(segment, addressExact.invokeExact(segment) as Long)
        }
    }

    private fun foreign(simpleName: String): Class<*> = try {
        Class.forName("java.lang.foreign." + simpleName)
    } catch (e: ClassNotFoundException) {
        throw UnsupportedOperationException(
            "java.lang.foreign is not available: the generated wrappers need JDK 21 with --enable-preview, or JDK 22 and later",
            e,
        )
    }

    /** Loads the shared library into this JVM, where the loader lookup of [downcall] finds its symbols. */
    fun loadLibrary(absolutePath: String) {
        System.load(absolutePath)
    }

    /**
     * Binds `symbol` to a downcall handle. `signature` is a JVM-descriptor-like string over `J` (long, every
     * pointer and every `int64_t`), `D` (double), `B` (byte, `uint8_t`) and `I` (int, a status), with `V` as a
     * return for void: `(JDB)I`. Link time only.
     */
    fun downcall(symbol: String, signature: String): MethodHandle {
        val close = signature.indexOf(')')
        require(signature.startsWith("(") && close > 0 && close == signature.length - 2) {
            "malformed signature " + signature + " for " + symbol
        }
        val optional = lookupFind.invoke(loaderLookup, symbol) as java.util.Optional<*>
        val segment = optional.orElseThrow { UnsatisfiedLinkError("symbol not found in the loaded library: " + symbol) }
        val parameters = signature.substring(1, close)
        val layouts = ReflectArray.newInstance(memoryLayoutClass, parameters.length)
        for (i in parameters.indices) ReflectArray.set(layouts, i, layoutOf(parameters[i]))
        val returned = signature[close + 1]
        val descriptor = if (returned == 'V') {
            functionDescriptorOfVoid.invoke(null, layouts)
        } else {
            functionDescriptorOf.invoke(null, layoutOf(returned), layouts)
        }
        return downcallHandleMethod.invoke(linker, segment, descriptor, noOptions) as MethodHandle
    }

    private fun layoutOf(code: Char): Any = when (code) {
        'J' -> layoutLong
        'D' -> layoutDouble
        'B' -> layoutByte
        'I' -> layoutInt
        else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("unknown carrier type " + code)
    }

    // Memory at a native address. Each is one invokeExact on a handle resolved above.
    fun readLong(address: Long): Long = getLong.invokeExact(address) as Long
    fun readDouble(address: Long): Double = getDouble.invokeExact(address) as Double
    fun readByte(address: Long): Byte = getByte.invokeExact(address) as Byte
    fun writeLong(address: Long, value: Long) = putLong.invokeExact(address, value) as Unit
    fun writeDouble(address: Long, value: Double) = putDouble.invokeExact(address, value) as Unit
    fun writeByte(address: Long, value: Byte) = putByte.invokeExact(address, value) as Unit

    /**
     * The calling thread's scratch block for out pointers: [SCRATCH_BYTES] bytes (16 slots of 8), aligned to 16.
     * One block per thread, so concurrent calls from several threads never share an out slot, and a call needs no
     * allocation. A call must not nest another call that uses the block before it has read its results.
     */
    fun scratch(): Long = scratchLocal.get().address

    /** Reads the calling thread's last failure through the library's `last_error` function (type `(JJ)I`). */
    fun lastError(lastErrorHandle: MethodHandle): TypedPythonAotException {
        val slots = scratch()
        val status = lastErrorHandle.invokeExact(slots, slots + 8L) as Int
        if (status != 0) {
            return TypedPythonAotException("UnknownError", "the library reported a failure but kept no error record")
        }
        return TypedPythonAotException(readCString(readLong(slots)), readCString(readLong(slots + 8L)))
    }

    /** A NUL-terminated UTF-8 string at `address` (error path only). */
    fun readCString(address: Long): String {
        if (address == 0L) return ""
        var length = 0L
        while (length < MAX_C_STRING && readByte(address + length).toInt() != 0) length++
        val bytes = ByteArray(length.toInt())
        for (i in bytes.indices) bytes[i] = readByte(address + i)
        return String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
    }

    private companion object {
        const val SCRATCH_BYTES = 128L
        const val MAX_C_STRING = 1L shl 20
    }
}
